title: Sang-Bai-Pi extract and its constituent regiafuran C ameliorate renal fibrosis through TGF-beta/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathways.
authors: Wei, Quan-Hao; Pan, Yin-Bo; Tian, Lin-Lin; Wang, Yu-Song; Wang, Jin-Yan; Liu, Xiang; Zhang, Hua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桑白皮提取物及成分改善肾纤维化的信号通路机制，涉及TGF-beta/Smad和Wnt/beta-catenin，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Renal fibrosis is a major pathological feature of many chronic kidney diseases, and traditional Chinese medicines (TCM) have shown promising therapeutic potential for treating renal fibrosis. Although the extracts or fractions of Morus alba leaves and twigs have been reported to ameliorate renal fibrosis, the beneficial effects of M. alba root bark (commonly known as Sang-Bai-Pi), a well-known TCM, on this disorder have not been investigated. PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the effects and mechanisms of Sang-Bai-Pi extract/fractions and their constituents on renal fibrosis. METHODS: Immunoblotting was first used to assess the effects of different Sang-Bai-Pi fractions on key fibrotic markers. The most potent fraction, EA-3, was further evaluated using a unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) rat model to assess its antifibrotic effects. The efficacy of EA-3 was evaluated by analyzing the pathomorphological changes in the kidney tissues of rats using histological staining and by detecting the expression of relevant proteins via Western blotting. The transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1)-stimulated human renal proximal tubular cell line HK-2 was used to elucidate the likely modes of action of EA-3 and its constituent regiafuran C (RFC). Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses were utilized to explore the detailed molecular mechanism of RFC. RESULTS: Fraction EA3 effectively alleviated UUO-induced renal fibrosis in rats. Mechanistically, EA-3 suppressed the epithelial-mesenchymal transition, accumulation of extracellular matrix, and activation of the TGF-beta/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathways in vitro and in vivo. RFC also demonstrated antifibrotic potential by inhibiting TGF-beta/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in HK-2 cells. Further investigations revealed that RFC inhibited TGF-beta/Smad pathway by blocking the interaction of Smad3 with TGF-betaRII and TGF-betaRI might be a potential direct target of RFC. CONCLUSION: The antirenal fibrotic effects of Sang-Bai-Pi extract/fractions and the constituent RFC were evaluated for the first time. Fraction EA-3 and RFC alleviated renal fibrosis by targeting the TGF-beta/Smad and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways. These findings provide valuable insights into the development of Sang-Bai-Pi-based phytotherapy and new drug molecules for the safe treatment of renal diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾纤维化是许多慢性肾脏疾病的主要病理特征，传统中药（TCM）在治疗肾纤维化方面显示出良好的治疗潜力。尽管桑（Morus alba）叶和嫩枝的提取物或部位已被报道可改善肾纤维化，但桑白皮（Morus alba root bark，俗称桑白皮（Sang-Bai-Pi）），一种知名中药，对此疾病的有益作用尚未被研究。目的：本研究旨在探讨桑白皮提取物/部位及其成分对肾纤维化的影响和机制。方法：首先使用免疫印迹法评估不同桑白皮部位对关键纤维化标志物的影响。最有效的部位EA-3进一步通过单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）大鼠模型评估其抗纤维化作用。通过组织学染色分析大鼠肾组织的病理形态学变化，并通过Western blotting检测相关蛋白的表达来评估EA-3的疗效。使用转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）刺激的人肾近端小管细胞系HK-2来阐明EA-3及其成分regiafuran C（RFC）可能的的作用模式。利用网络药理学和分子对接分析探讨RFC的详细分子机制。结果：EA-3部位有效缓解了UUO诱导的大鼠肾纤维化。机制上，EA-3在体外和体内抑制了上皮-间质转化、细胞外基质积累以及TGF-β/Smad和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路的激活。RFC也通过抑制HK-2细胞中的TGF-β/Smad和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路显示出抗纤维化潜力。进一步研究表明，RFC通过阻断Smad3与TGF-βRII的相互作用来抑制TGF-β/Smad通路，而TGF-βRI可能是RFC的潜在直接靶点。结论：首次评估了桑白皮提取物/部位及成分RFC的抗肾纤维化作用。EA-3部位和RFC通过靶向TGF-β/Smad和Wnt/β-catenin通路缓解肾纤维化。这些发现为基于桑白皮的植物疗法和用于安全治疗肾脏疾病的新药分子的开发提供了宝贵见解。
